text: Toxic Gas Leak Kills 2 at West Virginia Chemical Plant | Emergency Declared | U.S. NewsA deadly industrial accident has unfolded in West Virginia, where a toxic gas leak at a chemical plant has claimed at least two lives, with emergency crews rushing to contain the situation. Authorities have confirmed that the leak occurred within the facility, exposing workers to hazardous gas. While details about the exact chemical involved are still emerging, first responders and hazardous materials teams have been deployed to secure the site and prevent further spread. The incident has raised serious concerns about industrial safety standards, emergency preparedness, and the risks associated with chemical plants operating near populated areas.
